require 'sinatra'
require 'json'
require 'securerandom'

class SearchIndex
  STOP_WORDS = Set.new(%w[the a an is are was were be been being have has had do does did will would shall should may might can could])
  MAX_DOCUMENT_SIZE = 1_048_576
  MAX_TOKENS_PER_DOC = 10_000

  def initialize
    @index = {}
    @documents = {}
    @token_counts = Hash.new(0)
  end

  def add_document(doc_id, content)
    return { error: 'Document too large' } if content.bytesize > MAX_DOCUMENT_SIZE

    tokens = tokenize(content)
    return { error: 'Too many tokens' } if tokens.length > MAX_TOKENS_PER_DOC

    @documents[doc_id] = { content: content, indexed_at: Time.now }
    
    tokens.each do |token|
      normalized = normalize_token(token)
      next if normalized.nil? || normalized.empty?
      next if STOP_WORDS.include?(normalized)
      
      insert_to_index(normalized, doc_id)
      @token_counts[normalized] += 1
    end

    { success: true, doc_id: doc_id, token_count: tokens.length }
  end

  def search(query, limit: 20)
    query_tokens = tokenize(query).map { |t| normalize_token(t) }.compact
    return [] if query_tokens.empty?

    scores = Hash.new(0.0)
    query_tokens.each do |qt|
      next unless @index.key?(qt)
      @index[qt].each do |doc_id|
        scores[doc_id] += compute_relevance(qt, doc_id)
      end
    end

    scores.sort_by { |_, v| -v }.first(limit).map { |doc_id, score| { id: doc_id, score: score } }
  end

  private

  def tokenize(text)
    text.scan(/[\w]+/)
  end

  def normalize_token(token)
    return nil if token.nil?
    normalized = token.downcase.gsub(/[^a-z0-9]/, '')
    return nil if normalized.length > 128
    stem(normalized)
  end

  def stem(word)
    # Porter stemmer simplified - suffix stripping
    word = word.dup
    suffixes = ['ational', 'tional', 'enci', 'anci', 'izer', 'abli', 'alli', 'entli', 'eli', 'ousli', 'ization', 'ation', 'ator', 'alism', 'iveness', 'fulness', 'ousness', 'aliti', 'iviti', 'biliti', 'logi', 'ing', 'tion', 'ed', 'ly', 'er', 'es', 's']
    suffixes.each do |suffix|
      if word.end_with?(suffix) && word.length - suffix.length >= 3
        word = word[0...(word.length - suffix.length)]
        break
      end
    end
    word
  end

  def insert_to_index(token, doc_id)
    @index[token] ||= build_posting_list
    @index[token].add(doc_id)
  end

  def build_posting_list
    SortedPostingList.new
  end

  def compute_relevance(token, doc_id)
    tf = @token_counts[token].to_f
    idf = Math.log((@documents.size + 1.0) / (@index[token]&.size.to_f + 1.0))
    tf * idf
  end
end

class SortedPostingList
  def initialize
    @entries = []
  end

  def add(doc_id)
    insertion_point = find_insertion_point(doc_id)
    return if insertion_point < @entries.length && @entries[insertion_point] == doc_id
    @entries.insert(insertion_point, doc_id)
  end

  def each(&block)
    @entries.each(&block)
  end

  def size
    @entries.length
  end

  def include?(doc_id)
    idx = find_insertion_point(doc_id)
    idx < @entries.length && @entries[idx] == doc_id
  end

  private

  def find_insertion_point(doc_id)
    # Binary search for sorted insertion
    lo = 0
    hi = @entries.length
    while lo < hi
      mid = (lo + hi) / 2
      if @entries[mid] < doc_id
        lo = mid + 1
      else
        hi = mid
      end
    end
    lo
  end
end

index = SearchIndex.new

post '/upload' do
  content_type :json
  
  payload = JSON.parse(request.body.read) rescue nil
  return { error: 'Invalid JSON' }.to_json unless payload
  
  content = payload['content'].to_s
  doc_id = SecureRandom.uuid
  
  result = index.add_document(doc_id, content)
  result.to_json
end

get '/search' do
  content_type :json
  query = params['q'].to_s
  return { error: 'Empty query' }.to_json if query.empty?
  
  results = index.search(query, limit: 20)
  { results: results }.to_json
end
